descricao_original: Another image of the mucosal folds of the ampulla demonstrate the ciliated and secretory cells essential for the movement and nourishment of the secondary ooctye, sperm and embryo. These cells reach peak activity around the time of ovulation under the influence of high estrogen levels. 100x
